explanation: The value is 0 at every D1 and D2 step and at every GO step before about trial 80; at GO late in the episode it climbs with trial number, from about 3 at trials 82-90 to about 8 at trials 91-94 and 9-10 at trials 95-99, and it goes higher still the longer the run of recent rewarded trials. If the previous trial was unrewarded, that GO drops by about 4 (to roughly 4-6, or 3 at the very end), and after two or more unrewarded trials in a row it falls to near 0, especially when the agent then picks a2.
